category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, increase relative-ranking supervision to 0.95 BPR + 0.05 pointwise logistic. Retain zero-margin softplus BPR, valid-position averaging, and all architecture, sampling and optimization settings. No predictor changes are needed because inference and checkpoint shapes are unchanged.

change_summary: Adjust only the loss mixture for all four independent HSTU models and enforce the required data-directory environment variable.
